requirements.text: The external surface of the front bumper shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
atomic: The external surface of the front bumper shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

The external surface of the front bumper shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

requirements.text: The external surface of the front bumper shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the external surface of the front bumper shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, except that this requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm.
requirements.quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm. This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm

requirements.text: Where parts of the external surface of the front bumper protrude less than 5 mm, the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, except where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: Protruding parts of the external surface of the front bumper may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm only if they are made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A.
requirements.quote: Protruding parts of the external surface, made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The hardness measurement of protruding parts of the external surface of the front bumper shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement of the front bumper component by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
requirements.quote: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.

requirements.text: Added ornaments on the front bumper which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted, except that these provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles, to which only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.
requirements.quote: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted. These provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles, to which only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.
atomic: Added ornaments on the front bumper which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted.
Ornaments on radiator grilles of the front bumper shall meet the general requirements of paragraph 5.

requirements.text: To apply the 10 daN force to added ornaments on the front bumper, a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used.
requirements.quote: To apply the 10 daN force a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used.

requirements.text: Where it is not possible to apply the 10 daN force to added ornaments on the front bumper with a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter, an equivalent method shall be used.
requirements.quote: Where this is not possible, an equivalent method shall be used.

requirements.text: After the added ornaments on the front bumper are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.
requirements.quote: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.

requirements.text: After the added ornaments on the front bumper are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.
requirements.quote: These projections shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.

requirements.text: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface of the front bumper shall be firmly secured to the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface shall not be subject to the requirements of paragraph 6.1.1. above; however, they shall be firmly secured to the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the requirements of paragraph 5.4. are not applied to gaps between fixed or movable elements of the front bumper, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, the distance between consecutive elements shall not exceed 40 mm and the grilles and gaps shall have a functional purpose.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
atomic: Where the requirements of paragraph 5.4. are not applied to gaps between elements of the front bumper grilles, the distance between consecutive elements shall not exceed 40 mm.
Where the requirements of paragraph 5.4. are not applied to gaps between elements of the front bumper grilles, the grilles and gaps shall have a functional purpose.

requirements.text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm between consecutive elements of the front bumper grilles and gaps, the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.quote: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.

requirements.text: If the distance between two consecutive elements of the front bumper grilles and gaps is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.quote: However, if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps of the front bumper shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap of the front bumper shall be blunted.
requirements.quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling, this requirement being considered satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling. This requirement is considered to be satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
atomic: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
Where the bumper is not recessed or integrated within the bodywork, the end of the bumper shall be turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere.
Where the bumper is not recessed or integrated within the bodywork, the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork shall not exceed 20 mm.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, in that part of the zone which is situated between and in front of tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1).
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward ... This provision applies to that part of the zone lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward which is situated between and in front (or rear in case of the rear bumper) of tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1).

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.quote: and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of parts on or of the bumper or of bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers, shall be blunted, except where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers; but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The bumper cover shall comply with the provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above does not apply to the bumper cover. The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable.

requirements.text: Folds in body panels may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection, measured in accordance with the method described in paragraph 1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Folds in body panels may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection, measured in accordance with the method described in paragraph 1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
